about: Fort Saskatchewan is a city on the North Saskatchewan River northeast of Edmonton, in Alberta’s Industrial Heartland. It began as a North-West Mounted Police fort and grew with petrochemical plants along the river valley. A historic downtown, river valley trails, and a large Dow chemical complex define the modern city. About 27,000 people live in Fort Saskatchewan.
